name: atompay-paypal
description: AtomPay — AI-Guided Two-Phase Commit (2PC) Atomic Multi-Vendor Checkout Engine for PayPal

scripts.install:all: npm install --include=dev && npm --prefix backend install --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev
scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
